data.one_liner: A declarative router for Flutter with focus on state and nested navigation.
data.what_it_does: Octopus is a cross-platform declarative router for Flutter that handles navigation through state mutations and a tree structure of nodes. It supports nested navigation, state history, guards, and representing the entire navigation tree in URLs and deep links.
use_when: You need complex nested navigation of arbitrary depth.
You want a truly declarative router driven by state mutations rather than push/pop commands.
You need to persist and represent the entire navigation tree in URLs and deep links.
avoid_when: You prefer conventional imperative navigation or path-templating routers.
You want code-generated routes and typed arguments out of the box.
strengths: Preserves and displays the entire navigation tree in URLs
Built-in guard system for intercepting navigation and handling authentication
weaknesses: Requires learning a custom state mutation approach rather than standard path templating
Young library with potential ecosystem changes

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: More widely adopted declarative router with standard path-templating and official Flutter team support.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: Strong focus on strongly-typed arguments and code generation for nested navigation.

alternatives.name: beamer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Declarative routing based on location-based delegates for nested navigation.
